_guide:
CAU HINH CAC DROPDOWN (COMBobox) cho dialog nhap thong tin nguoi dung khi chay/cai lai Agent.
Quan tri vien co the sua truc tiep file nay (khong can build lai Agent):
 - Them/bot dropdown bang cach sua mang 'fields' ben duoi.
 - Moi dropdown gom 3 thuoc tinh:
     + key     : ma dinh danh (dung de luu + gui len server).
     + label   : nhan hien thi tren dialog.
     + options : danh sach lua chon (array chuoi).
 - key 'branch' se duoc luu vao truong 'Van phong/chi nhanh' cua tai san 'Nguoi dung' tren server.
 - Luu file theo ma UTF-8. Khong dung dau nhay don (') trong label/options de tranh loi hien thi.

Vi du muon them dropdown 'Phong ban':
  {
    "key": "department",
    "label": "Phong ban",
    "options": ["IT", "HR", "Ke toan", "Kinh doanh"]
  }
